deliveryComponents: Though controversy has swirled around Hollywood over the use of AI in movies, A24 would be far from the first studio to explore integrating AI into the creative process. Netflix announced earlier this year that it was buying Ben Affleck’s company, InterPositive, which creates AI tools for filmmakers. Last year, meanwhile, Amazon’s MGM Studios launched an AI unit focused on developing tools for television and movie production.

specificationFacts.source_quote: Google Deepmind unveils Gemini Robotics 2 to power robots of all shapes from tabletop arms to humanoids

Google Deepmind has introduced Gemini Robotics 2, which it calls its most advanced vision-language-action (VLA) model yet. VLA models combine image recognition, language processing, and action control to help robots operate in physical environments. Deepmind says the model can control systems ranging from tabletop arms to full-body humanoid robots.
Google DeepMind has released Gemini Robotics 2 , the intelligence layer for its next generation of robots.
IT之家 7 月 31 日消息，谷歌 DeepMind 昨日（7 月 30 日）发布博文，宣布推出 Gemini Robotics ER 2 模型， 是其面向机器人的最强具身推理（embodied reasoning）模型。
